integrationPrinciple: Eight AR tasks active in content; Android/ARCore integration untested; equal 2D fallback required.
arAltitudePolicy: Do not use legacy Unity altitude as absolute vertical AR alignment. Use user placement, visual alignment or field-verified geospatial anchor only.

proposals.title: Пронађи торањ
proposals.interaction: Player points the camera toward City Hall; a translucent outline or visual guide highlights the tower, then a short historical year prompt appears.

proposals.title: Геније боја — три епохе
proposals.interaction: Player selects blue (1929–1933), red (1934–1940), grey (1945–1952) cards in their historical order, without needing real painting images. Three short original graphic brush strokes; same order task in 2D fallback.

proposals.title: Izgubljeni znak - sastavi pozornicu
proposals.interaction: Map curtain, actor and audience to three stage slots; identical AR and 2D role game.

proposals.title: Santa Maria della Salute — stihovi u vazduhu
proposals.interaction: Reorder three title cards Santa / Maria / della Salute in AR or identical 2D fallback; canonical full title Santa Maria della Salute.

proposals.title: Nedovršeni film — tri kadra
proposals.interaction: Arrange 1906 projector, 1909 camera and 1914 unrealized studio cards, then play original vector montage. Same 2D task.

proposals.title: Кофер сећања — три трага
proposals.interaction: Player selects three original symbolic cards in historical order: Danube arrival → everyday community life → museum memory. 2D equivalent has the same objective, scores and mandatory context.

proposals.title: Golubičin let — tri pisma vremena
proposals.interaction: Order three sourced cards Sombor 1884 → Budapest Tekelijanum 1902 → Sombor memorial 2017; same 2D game.

proposals.title: Tri sata — događaj, slika, sala
proposals.interaction: Map 1697 battle / 1896 painting / 1898 installation to three roles, with identical 2D fallback

reviewRule: AR tasks are required for the mission but must always be completable via equally rewarded 2D fallback; active in data is not synonymous with implemented in app.
